alt: A route over stones where each jump covers at most k stones. The dp array fills left to right. A deque of stone indices, with dp values decreasing from front to back, sits beside it. Stones older than the window leave the front, the front gives the best predecessor, and weaker entries leave the back before the new stone joins.
